meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
Choosing the right serum for acne-prone skin depends on your primary concern—whether you are dealing with **active breakouts/excess oil**, **clogged pores**, or **dark marks left behind by old acne (PIH)**.

Several top-tier, dermatologist-tested serums available in India are priced **under ₹700**:

---

### 1. Best for Overall Oil Control & Acne Marks: Minimalist 10% Niacinamide + Zinc Face Serum

* **Price:** ~₹570 - ₹599 (30 ml)[www.makeupholicworld.com](https://www.makeupholicworld.com/2026/05/best-face-serum-for-indian-skin-2026vitamin-c-niacinamide-retinol-hyaluronic-acid/#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%20Niacinamide%2010%25%20%2B%20Zinc%20Face,excess%20oil%20further%20and%20has%20anti-bacterial%20properties.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 10% Niacinamide, 1% Zinc PCA, Matmarine[www.makeupholicworld.com](https://www.makeupholicworld.com/2026/05/best-face-serum-for-indian-skin-2026vitamin-c-niacinamide-retinol-hyaluronic-acid/#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%20Niacinamide%2010%25%20%2B%20Zinc%20Face,excess%20oil%20further%20and%20has%20anti-bacterial%20properties.)
* **Why it works:** This is widely considered a holy-grail starter serum for Indian oily and acne-prone skin.[www.makeupholicworld.com](https://www.makeupholicworld.com/2026/05/best-face-serum-for-indian-skin-2026vitamin-c-niacinamide-retinol-hyaluronic-acid/#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%20Niacinamide%2010%25%20%2B%20Zinc%20Face,excess%20oil%20further%20and%20has%20anti-bacterial%20properties.) Niacinamide regulates sebum production and fades dark spots, while Zinc has anti-bacterial properties that curb active breakouts.[www.makeupholicworld.com](https://www.makeupholicworld.com/2026/05/best-face-serum-for-indian-skin-2026vitamin-c-niacinamide-retinol-hyaluronic-acid/#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%20Niacinamide%2010%25%20%2B%20Zinc%20Face,excess%20oil%20further%20and%20has%20anti-bacterial%20properties.)
* **Alternative:** *The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Face Serum with 2% Zinc* (~₹349–₹599) or *The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%* (~₹600).[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-serum#:~:text=2%20Sizes.%20Brightening.%20%E2%82%B9699%E2%82%B962910%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped,Oil%20Control.%202%20Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9649%E2%82%B953218%25%20Off.%20Anua.)

### 2. Best for Active Acne, Whiteheads & Blackheads: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Price:** ~₹549 (30 ml)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-serum#:~:text=Niacinamide%2010%20Txa%204%20Serum%2C%20Brightening%20Korean,10%25%20Night%20Clarity%20Jelly%20Serum.%202%20Sizes.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid (BHA), Centella Water
* **Why it works:** If you suffer from frequent pimples, clogged pores, or bumpy skin texture, Salicylic Acid is a oil-soluble exfoliant that dives deep into pores to dissolve trapped sebum and dead skin cells.[maynee.in](https://maynee.in/best-face-serums-2026-guide/#:~:text=The%20best%20serum%20for%20oily%20skin%20contains,shows%20they%20work%20very%20well%20together.%20For) Centella water helps soothe the redness associated with angry pimples.
* *Note: Introduce this slowly (2–3 nights a week) so you don't dry out your skin barrier.*

### 3. Best for Sensitive Acne-Prone Skin: Dot & Key Cica + 10% Niacinamide Spot Reduction Face Serum

* **Price:** ~₹479 - ₹599 (30 ml)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-niacinamide/c/20708#:~:text=Glycolic%20Bright%208%25%20%5BMelasyl%20%2B%20Niacinamide%5D%20Face,%E2%82%B929.%20Murad.%20Rapid%20Dark%20Spot%20Correcting%20Serum.)
* **Key Ingredients:** Cica (Centella Asiatica), 10% Niacinamide, Green Tea
* **Why it works:** If your skin gets easily irritated, red, or inflamed by strong actives, Cica is a phenomenal calming ingredient. This formula pairs the oil-balancing benefits of Niacinamide with deeply soothing botanicals to heal acne scars without causing flare-ups.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-niacinamide/c/20708#:~:text=Brightening.%20%E2%82%B9599%E2%82%B950915%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B929.,For%20All%20Skin%20Types.%20Brightening.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.)

---

### Quick Recommendation Guide:

* Choose **Salicylic Acid** if you have **active, recurring pimples, blackheads, or whiteheads**.
* Choose **Niacinamide + Zinc** if your main struggles are **excess oiliness and post-acne dark spots/marks**.

Which specific skin concern would you like to target first?
